description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying {1}{G}.
Cast Giada by paying {1}{W}.
When Giada enters, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Scurry Oak's second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel due to Divine Visitation that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other Angel you control due to Giada.
When the Angel token enters, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.
